review.rationale: The supplied frozen Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scopes, and required evidence stages agree with the original specification. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical benchmark input without representing it as a human Decision; ready with no decision blocker is therefore appropriate here. An unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B must instead block at decisions, before later prerequisites. The source evidence supports the four writable implementation owners and the specified regression/type-test scope. Existing merge, forwarding, export, and hook declaration consumers can remain inspection-only: their generic handling propagates the option without requiring separate edits. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated, not separately maintained owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for compile-time checks. The two distinct allowed agents have matching delivery roles, auto-assignable memberships, availability, and active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant TypeScript, contract, state, data-change, asynchronous-consumer, failure-handling, and testing capabilities; verification additionally has testing.verification. The configured independent reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Pending legacy claims and personas are not used as substitutes for trusted claims. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD persistence normalization. Historical operations are retained as old-version evidence, not fresh candidate evidence. This assessment uses only the supplied review data and Service-reported mechanical bindings; I neither recomputed digests nor executed code, and make no new human attestation.
